scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.RIB_REQUESTDETAILS WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST(@DatetoProcessed AS DATE);

INSERT INTO EDS.RIB_REQUESTDETAILS
(
	AS_OF_DATE
,	ACC_ID
,	ACCOUNT_BANK_ID
,	BACKEND_REF_ID
,	BANK_ID
,	BRANCH_ID
,	CORP_ID
,	CORP_USER
,	CUST_ID
,	DB_TS
,	DEL_FLG
,	FORM_REQ_ID
,	FORM_REQ_STATE
,	FTXN_ID
,	MODULE_ID
,	NO_RM_DAEMON_TRIES
,	ORG_EXT_INFO
,	ORG_MOD_NAME
,	PRODUCT_ID
,	R_CRE_ID
,	R_CRE_TIME
,	R_MOD_ID
,	R_MOD_TIME
,	REQ_ENTITY_EXTN1
,	REQ_ENTITY_ID
,	REQ_ENTITY_TYPE
,	REQUEST_MODE
,	RESP_CODE
,	RQST_ID
,	LAST6_ACCT_NUM
,	isActive
,	isLatest
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
@DatetoProcessed AS AS_OF_DATE
,	ACC_ID
,	ACCOUNT_BANK_ID
,	BACKEND_REF_ID
,	BANK_ID
,	BRANCH_ID
,	CORP_ID
,	CORP_USER
,	CUST_ID
,	DB_TS
,	DEL_FLG
,	FORM_REQ_ID
,	FORM_REQ_STATE
,	FTXN_ID
,	MODULE_ID
,	NO_RM_DAEMON_TRIES
,	ORG_EXT_INFO
,	ORG_MOD_NAME
,	PRODUCT_ID
,	R_CRE_ID
,	R_CRE_TIME
,	R_MOD_ID
,	R_MOD_TIME
,	REQ_ENTITY_EXTN1
,	REQ_ENTITY_ID
,	REQ_ENTITY_TYPE
,	REQUEST_MODE
,	RESP_CODE
,	RQST_ID
,	LAST6_ACCT_NUM
,	1 as isActive
,	1 as isLatest
,	BANK_ID as BNK_CODE
,	'RIB' as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_RIB_REQUESTDETAILS
WHERE H = 'D'
